## Checklist

- [ ] Every new rule has a source link and a tag (`[REG]`, `[STD]`, `[RES]`, `[PRAC]`, `[INF]`)

- [ ] No logos, tell-tale artwork, proprietary fonts or vehicle/app screenshots
